source: Live production demo — demo.synderapp.com/ui/transactionReconciliation/create, app v11.7.88, org 'Per transaction test' (QuickBooks Online: Sandbox Company_US_1). Captured read-only 2026-09-25 by Playwright; no reconciliation submitted (only mixpanel/rum POSTs observed). Raw text in reference/.
authority: Production is the behavioural reference for layout, field order, labels and mode rules. Where production contradicts the SET spec (Confluence 3701506049), say so rather than picking one.

screen.header: 'Reconciliation details' full-screen overlay; Back button; primary 'Run reconciliation' top right; chips 'Included in your plan' · 'Doesn't use your sync credits'.
screen.left_rail: 'Get started with reconciling': 1. Set the date range — 'Monthly reconciliation is the most common approach.' 2. Select integration — 'Choose the integration you want to reconcile. Reconciliation is done one integration at a time.' 3. Choose import method — 'Select how to provide data: retrieve files automatically or upload them manually.'
screen.date_range: 'Date range *' two date inputs, prefilled 08/01/2026 – 08/31/2026 (last full month). No preset list.
screen.layout: Two columns side by side: 'Accounting' and 'Integration'.
screen.accounting_column: 'Platform' = 'Sandbox Company_US_1 (QuickBooks Online)'; 'Import method *' react-select, visible from the start (before any integration), default 'Automated', options 'Automated · Recommended · Synder automatically retrieves, maps, and matches the necessary files for you.' / 'Manual · Upload your files and set up mapping rules yourself.'; helper 'Synder will automatically retrieve the necessary files for you and will map the data according to these matching rules.' with 'matching rules' as an inline link.
screen.integration_column: 'Integration *' react-select, empty 'Select...'. Options are named connections: 'mzkt.by (Stripe)', 'Synder test (Stripe)', 'No integration — reconcile a GL account'. After pick: helper 'Timezone: Etc/UTC' (per connection; mzkt.by shows Europe/Minsk). Then 'Account to reconcile *' appears (empty 'Select...').
screen.account_list: Grouped headings in caps: 'SYNDER ACCOUNTS (AUTOMATED DATA RETRIEVAL)' → 'Stripe Synder test (required for Synder)'; 'SYNDER ACCOUNTS (MANUAL FILE UPLOAD REQUIRED)' → Balance Reserve, Checking, Cost of Goods Sold, Inventory Asset, Inventory Shrinkage, Purchases, Stripe expenses, Stripe fees, Stripe Lending Liability, Stripe Other fees, Stripe sales. P&L accounts ARE offered. 'No integration' lists all 174 GL accounts, ungrouped.
screen.after_account: Helper 'Currency: USD'. A second 'Import method *' appears in the Integration column.
screen.clearing_account: Integration Import method default 'Automated'; options Automated (Recommended) / Assisted ('Upload required files — Synder will handle mapping, normalization, and matching.') / Manual. Helpers: 'Automatic file retrieval can take some time — up to a few hours.' + 'Synder will automatically retrieve … matching rules.'
screen.manual_account: (Stripe fees, Checking) Integration Import method = 'Manual' only; 'Upload file *' dropzone 'Browse or drag your file here' / 'CSV or XLSX formats, up to 100MB'. The ACCOUNTING column stays 'Automated' with both options available — production does NOT force the accounting side to Manual.
screen.integration_switch: Changing the integration after choosing an account clears the account back to 'Select...'.
screen.validation: Run with empty form: inline 'Required' under Integration. No top banner.
screen.footer: Site footer (About / Contact us / Legal / v11.7.88) renders inside the overlay.
